newsitem.title: FRANCE: Zaire's Mobutu arrives on French Riviera.
newsitem.headline: Zaire's Mobutu arrives on French Riviera.

text.p: Ailing President Mobutu Sese Seko left Zaire and arrived at his French Riviera holiday mansion on Friday as representatives of his government and rebels holding part of eastern Zaire haggled in South Africa over peace talks.
French officials said Mobutu's private plane touched down at Nice airport at seven p.m. (1800 GMT) from Gbadolite, his home town in Zaire. He was expected to stay in France for four days.
Mobutu, who was underwent surgery for prostate cancer in Switzerland in August and convalesced at his French residence, returned to France for three weeks last month for medical tests.

It was not known if he would meet French officials or other envoys at his coastal mansion in Roquebrune Cap-Martin as he did during previous stays when several African leaders consulted about the crisis in Zaire.
In Cape Town, a U.S. embassy official said South Africa was leading proximity talks in a search for peace in Zaire, where the government has intensified air raids against rebel strongholds.
South African officials remained silent about progress towards a face-to-face meeting in Cape Town between representatives of Mobutu's government and the rebels led by Laurent Kabila.

Zaire says forces from Rwanda, Uganda and Burundi invaded its territory in support of Tutsi-led rebels who took up arms in October, accusing Zaire of denying them citizenship and preparing to expel them.
